label: EXPLORATORY_EXT1_TREATMENT_COVERAGE_FACTORIAL
question: Does the change in Ext1 directional joint evidence come from the treatment registry or from bar coverage?

b2_5m_hawkes_innovation.operation: map the historical design label to the current panel column in memory, preserve the historical coefficient label, and do not recompute the feature
b2_5m_hawkes_innovation.limit: the obsolete column is absent, so historical byte equality cannot be tested

august.interpretation: the same three BAR_SOURCES names used for the August Ext1 comparison

outcome.name: signed_return
outcome.sample: native horizon availability, matching the Ext1 joint-target battery

estimator.name: Ext1 cross-fitted partial-out DML joint Wald
estimator.treatment_design: registry transform plus fold-training median and scale; omit missingness-indicator columns so the joint block remains exactly 10 or 12 requested treatments

family.adjustment: Holm across all joint two-sided p-values

attribution.treatment_main_effect: mean over coverages of b2_panel_12 minus ext1_exact
attribution.coverage_main_effect: mean over treatment sets of complete minus august
attribution.aggregation: median absolute main effect across roles and primary horizons
attribution.classification: TREATMENT_SET if treatment shift is at least twice coverage shift; COVERAGE if coverage shift is at least twice treatment shift; otherwise MIXED_OR_INTERACTION
attribution.interpretation: descriptive attribution only because the treatment sets are not nested
